\title{Generates an Excel workbook containing information on all Analytical QC records that contain a given list of DTXSIDs}

  ids = NULL,
  include_classyfire = NULL,
  include_functional_uses = NULL,
  include_source_counts = NULL,
  methodologies = NULL
)
}

\item{ids}{ids}

\item{include_classyfire}{include_classyfire}

\item{include_functional_uses}{include_functional_uses}

\item{include_source_counts}{include_source_counts}

\item{methodologies}{methodologies}
}
\value{
Raw Excel workbook bytes. Errors retain typed HTTP or transport conditions.
